'''2001 San Diego Comic-Con Coruscant Pre-release (21 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG pre-release held at Comic-Con, San Diego, California on 21 July 2001. It is known from Alex Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2703">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-san-diego-comic-con-7-21-01d2703/ san-diego-comic-con-7-21-01], DeckTech (Alex "Yowza" Sanchez, 23 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-23-san-diego-comic-con-7-21-01d2703/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 San Diego Comic-Con Open]].

* '''Date:''' 21 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Comic-Con, San Diego, California
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 91
